about: Fixed questions for Bernie, run by scripts/bernie_eval.py before and after any change to her prompt, facts or retrieval. Each case is one conversation; a case with several turns asks them in the same thread. 'known_gap' marks an expectation that fails today on purpose, so a fix shows up as a gap closing rather than as nothing. Regulation expectations use words that appear in the rule text (regular expressions, case-insensitive) rather than article numbers, because the FIA renumbers between issues; article numbers are pinned only where they have been checked against the corpus.

turns.question: How many power unit elements can a driver use before getting a grid penalty?

cases.note: B8.2.8 states the penalty and refers to the allowances in B8.2.2-B8.2.4 without containing them. Lexical search does not reach those. Search now follows an article's references, which should close this gap; drop known_gap once a run against the real corpus shows it closed.

turns.question: How many power unit elements can a driver use before getting a grid penalty?

cases.note: While the allowance articles are not retrieved, Bernie must say what she has rather than supply the numbers from memory. Review this one by eye as well; the pattern only catches the plainest form.

turns.question: Exactly how many energy stores is each driver allowed this season?
What are teams allowed to change on the car under parc fermé conditions?
Can a team replace a driver after qualifying, and where would the new driver start?
Are drivers allowed to overtake while the safety car is deployed?
What do drivers have to do under a virtual safety car?
Does a driver have to use two different dry tyre compounds in a dry race?
Can teams change tyres while the race is suspended under a red flag?
What is the speed limit in the pit lane?
What is the difference between a drive-through penalty and a stop-and-go penalty?
What happens if a car is released unsafely from its pit stop?
When does a car have to start the race from the pit lane?
What happens to a driver who keeps going off the track and gains an advantage?
How many championship points does the race winner get?

cases.note: Answers must come from the qualifying classification in her facts, including on a follow-up turn.

turns.question: Who qualified on pole for this race?
And who qualified second?
Who is the most likely driver to finish on the podium, and how likely is it?

cases.note: Only runs while round 24 has no locked forecast; afterwards it is skipped.
